summary_ja: この告示は、企業再生支援機構法改正法の施行日（平成25年3月18日）から適用する。
summary_en: Provides that this Public Notice applies from March 18, 2013, the date the Act Partially Amending the Enterprise Turnaround Initiative Corporation of Japan Act came into force.
paragraphs: This Public Notice applies from the date of enforcement of the Act Partially Amending the Enterprise Turnaround Initiative Corporation of Japan Act (March 18, 2013).
